## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **The served CSP header cannot name per-page hashes — the policy is
   a meta ∩ header split by construction.** A static host cannot emit
   a per-route hash map without new generation machinery, and a header
   `default-src`/`script-src 'self'` would *deny* the hashed inline
   bootstrap the meta lawfully admits. The header carries exactly the
   meta-inexpressible + hash-independent guards; the browser's
   policy-intersection yields K0 §4.8's rows verbatim. ADR-223
   Decision 1; the per-route-hash conf artifact is the recorded
   revisit path.
2. **The T0 `default-src 'none'` row is a build-time meta rewrite.**
   Astro's `security.csp` is global config; `sig-page-types` already
   classifies every route, so `tightenT0Document` rewrites the T0
   pages' meta post-emit — and the e2e asserts the tightened shape on
   every discovered T0 route, so a missed page fails loud.
3. **The figure-SVG policy is a `map`, not a location.** A
   `location ~ \.svg$` would beat the `/r/` and `/s/` prefix locations
   and mis-root release-tree figures; the `$sig_csp` map keys on the
   request — the policy follows the bytes under every tree.
4. **`eval()` is proven under a planted hash-admitted policy.** CDP
   evaluation is CSP-exempt, so `page.evaluate`'s own eval can never
   violate; the leg embeds a hashed collector + probe script in a
   `setContent` document — the real blocking + reporting path.
   `addInitScript` likewise does not run on `setContent` documents;
   the collector rides the planted document.
5. **The mount-height reservation became a generated class table.**
   `style-src-attr 'none'` forbids `style="min-height: Nrem"`; the
   `--k0…--k24` classes carry the same `32 + 1.4×N` rem formula, and
   `map.astro` throws above k24 rather than silently under-reserving
   (SIG-ENG-042).
6. **The ContradictionRange track is now an inline `<svg>`.** The
   absolute-positioned `<span style="left: x%">` points became `cx`
   geometry attributes — geometry is not a style attribute, so no
   CSP exception is needed and the `<title>` child gives svg-native
   naming.
7. **`check:dom` scans `web/src/**` only.** MapLibre's own
   `innerHTML`/`setHTML` strings reside in `node_modules` — the ban
   governs authored source; test fixtures plant the sinks under
   `--src`, never in the scanned tree.
8. **HSTS ships without `preload`.** The preload-list submission is a
   public-origin commitment the launch row owns (ADR-223 Decision 6).

## Fix arc (recorded)

1. **CDP-exempt eval test → planted hash-admitted document** — the
   first eval leg used `page.evaluate`'s own eval, which is
   CSP-exempt and returned `threw=false`; the real block is proven by
   a hashed script inside a `setContent` document (Deviation 4).
2. **Control injection on an inherited-CSP document → fresh page** —
   `page.setContent` inherits the navigated document's policy
   container, so the "CSP-free" control still blocked the injected
   script; `browser.newPage()` gives a genuinely policy-free document.
3. **`location ~ \.svg$` → `$sig_csp` map** — the regex location would
   have mis-rooted `/r/<pub>/figure.svg` (regex beats prefix); the
   request-keyed map follows the bytes (Deviation 3).
4. **Ruff format** — two asserts reflowed by `ruff format` (mechanical,
   caught by `make format-check`).
5. **`changelog_gate` red on the first head** — the `docs` CI job failed
   `b85b3e3c` in 42 s: `web/src/pages/{map,network}.astro` are
   public-behaviour paths and the commit carried no `## [Unreleased]`
   entry and no `Changelog:` trailer. Repaired forward with the
   `### Security` entry (no amend — GH013); the gate reads
   `pass (CHANGELOG.md changed)` on `7f3b6923`.
